merchant/30519.htm.text: Grocer Mion: Please, buy something! My children need food and shoes...

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30519-pk.htm.text: Grocer Mion: I dream sometimes. Of a world where everyone gets along ... Do you think that world will come someday? Isn't that more important than making money?

Q00221_TestimonyOfProsperity/30519-01.ht.text: Trader Mion: That bloody old fool never forgets his donation money ! I have been too busy to bring it in. Here it is! Now take it to Elder Balanki. Who does he think he is? Won't even come to pick up the donation in person!

This is the reward, as promised. Please take it ... I still need more Spider Silk, so please collect more! But making twenty dresses will take forever ... What sho…

Q00296_TarantulasSpiderSilk/30519-04.htm.text: Trader Mion: Aghhh! What are you doing here? Hey ... I don't have time ... Just spin the silk out of them. If I don't have twenty dresses by next week, I will be kicked out of the Silver Scale Guild! I am telling you once more. You may receive Spider Silks only by hunting hunter tarantulas or plund…

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30519-01.html.text: Trader Mion: You're looking for my brother? But he wanders around here and there ... so it is very difficult to find him. More than that, he has made some kind of Teleport Device, so it is even harder to find him!! Well, how about this? If you help me with my work, I will see if I can find out wher…

links.text: Say you will help with the work

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30519-05.html.text: Trader Mion: Please go quickly! Our shop is famous for its quick deliveries! Don't worry about finding my brother, just hurry on!

Q00296_TarantulasSpiderSilk/30519-03.htm.text: Trader Mion: Ohh! Goddess Maphr sent me a savior! Good Lord! What took you so long! You don't have much time! Now I shall tell you about collecting the Spider Silk. Generally, people think that tarantulas do not make webs, but that is false. They dig holes for their nests and make webs to line them…

Q00296_TarantulasSpiderSilk/30519-06.htm.text: Trader Mion: No way! I'm in a hurry and you want to quit? Do you want me to die? I have to make dresses by the day after tomorrow ...! Mion will hate you and curse you! Aghhhh!

Q00296_TarantulasSpiderSilk/30519-07.htm.text: Trader Mion: Please hurry ... hurry! Tarantula Spider Silk! A lot! Hurry, hurry! Spinnerets are to go to Defender Nathan! Do you understand? Aghhh! Hurry, hurry! I'm about to die! Drink some honey tea and cheer up, Mion!

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30519-02.html.text: Trader Mion: Good! Then please take this potion to Priest of the Earth Zimenf and bring back the payment for it as well. Thank you in advance!

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30519-03.html.text: Trader Mion: Good! Then please take this weapon to Trader Shari . And you must bring back the payment for it! Thank you in advance!

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30519-04.html.text: Trader Mion: Good. Then please take this Lump of Iron to Head Blacksmith Bronk at the blacksmith's shop. And you must bring back the payment for it! Thank you in advance!

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30519-06.html.text: Trader Mion: All right, now! Well, don't just stand there ... go on!

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30519-07.html.text: Trader Mion: Excuse me! Do you know how hard it is to find my brother? Isn't it proper to do something in return to help? Humph ... you're too much ... Well, have it your way! Look for him all your life! See if you can find him, humph! Humph!

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30519-09.html.text: Trader Mion: Look here, now I almost know where my brother is! You can't pretend not to know me now, right? If you'd have waited a bit longer, you could have found my brother!! Truly, I am so sorry!

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30519-10.html.text: Dwarf Goods Trader Mion: Hmph! I thought I'd be able to boss you around for free thanks to my brother, but you're just as lazy as he is! It would be easier for me to just do it myself... My brother said that he was going to the northern coast to see the vast ocean. Heh...I imagine you'll find it a …

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30519-11.html.text: Trader Mion: Good! Now please deliver this item! Oh yes! Don't forget to bring back the payment! (It is quite hard to order someone around.) Ah ... Nothing, nothing! Go on!
